extension.summary: SiloMod for Kodi: browse and play your Silo server
extension.description: Unofficial Silo client for Kodi, built on Plex Uno (a reworked fork of PlexMod for Kodi)
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not made or supported by the Silo project or by Plex
extension.news: 0.1.0 - the first SiloMod test build - Sign in to a Silo server with a username and password or a phone code (with a QR code), and find servers on your network - Home, libraries, collections, shows, search, people, watchlist and favorites from Silo - Plays from Silo: the original file, or Silo's remux or transcode, with skip markers, seek-bar previews, theme music and Stream Info - Play All and Shuffle, path mapping to your own shares, and switching between Silo servers - Watch together: watch parties with Silo
